row.name: Fex-M3
row.description: A deadly, fast-acting nerve gas favored by the criminal underworld and elite bounty hunters. Ideal for aerosol payloads in gas grenades or proximity traps. Usually dispensed into a Chemical Storage Vessel. If the carrying container is breached, or it is dispensed without one: Deals 1d toxic damage to all targets in the immediate vicinity. If not deployed via a tailored explosive or aerosol device, the gas cloud expands unevenly, increasing its radius by 5 feet per second. Exposure: Targets must make an HT-3 (or Poison Resistance-3) roll. Failure: The victim suffers 1d-2 (minimum 1) toxic damage per second for 5 minutes. This effect can only be halted by an Antidote Kit.
